descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S13 「现成 spec：邮箱地址不能当交接收件人」 Existing spec: an email address is refused as a handoff recipient

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 No email or mailto that carries patient data, on any screen that shows patient data, in Hospital and in Nursing Home: no PHI is transmitted through an unencrypted path. …（UAT OAT-02 step 3；UAT OAT-02；UAT 3.3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress
  • U5 The handoff and the task list leave the app only through the in-app Send to a signed-in RoundCompanion recipient, never to an email address (step 3 'in app only').（UAT OAT-02 step 3；TFA-92586 AC 6；TFA-92586 AC 7；TFA-92585 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress; TFA-92586 ready for pr; TFA-92585 ready for pr

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Two accounts

When Call handoffs.send with toUserId 'someone@example.com' (and to self, and with empty text)

Then The server refuses with 'not a RoundCompanion user', so a handoff cannot be routed out to an email address even by a crafted call

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertion rejects.toThrow(/not a RoundCompanion user/) (step 3 'no email, in app only', enforced server-side)

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S13 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
